text:
Izzy Brooks: starting Kepler POC perf thread. customer goal = sustained 400 qps for short replies, but ~15% of requests are embeddings and ~7% have >1500 token context. target p95 <210ms. they asked for fp16, ptq-int8, awq-int8 runs + an embedding-mixed soak. who can own infra + corpus?
Kenji Sato: I can run this in dedicated us-central1. need a 1k-session corpus with embed labels; if none provided we'll synthesize 10% embed calls. recommend prefix caching for warm runs.
Fiona Marsh: test plan: 4m ramp, 30m steady @400 qps, 10m embed-mix soak, then 5m cooldown. capture p50/p95/p99, cold-start tail, kv-cache hit, GPU util, and token throughput. we'll do cold and warm variants.
deploy-bot: provisioning cluster/dedicated/us-central1/slotset-9 image=redwood-runtime:2026-04-05-rc status=allocating.
Izzy Brooks: also need cost estimates per 1M tokens for each quant and an ops recommendation if they want multi-az failover. include a short note on reserved-capacity pricing vs pay-as-you-go.
Kenji Sato: rough pre-run estimates: fp16 p95 ~200ms, ptq-int8 p95 ~230ms with extra jitter, awq-int8 p95 ~175-190ms but watch p99 on cold. GPU util guesses: fp16 65%, ptq 50%, awq 38%. cost ballpark: ptq ~0.6x, awq ~0.5x. I'll compute exact $/1M after runs.
Fiona Marsh: quality gate: 60-case eval focused on long-context coherence. flag any >3% accuracy regression or user-visible hallucinations. If regressions on >1500 token sessions, recommend canary to fp16 for that slice.
Kenji Sato: running fp16 baseline now. command used: \n```\nredwood-load --corpus s3://kepler-poc/1k-labelled.json --target 400 --ramp 4m --steady 30m --model redwood/v1.2 --quant fp16 --cache-prefix --output /artifacts/kepler/4012345678/fp16.csv\n```\ndeploy-bot: run complete -> /artifacts/kepler/4012345678/fp16.csv status=success
Kenji Sato: fp16 smoke: p95=198ms, p99=420ms, kv hit=69%, GPU util avg=63%. uploading csv.
Kenji Sato: ptq-int8 done -> /artifacts/kepler/4012345678/ptq.csv. ptq p95=235ms, p99=560ms, jitter during steady-state, kv hit=65%, GPU util 49%.
Kenji Sato: awq-int8 run complete -> /artifacts/kepler/4012345678/awq.csv. awq p95=183ms, p99=510ms with a few cold spikes ~680ms on long contexts, kv hit=75%, GPU util 36%. eval diff (60-case) shows 2 cases >3% accuracy drop, hallucination delta +0.9%.
Fiona Marsh: ops note for report: keep 12% headroom in capacity planning for embed spikes. multi-az failover doubles infra footprint and impacts reserved pricing; flag to sales.
Izzy Brooks: perfect. assemble 1-pg PDF with bullets, heatmaps, CSV attachments, cost per 1M tokens for each quant, reserved vs PAYG appendix, and the 60-case eval summary + canary recommendation. target EOD send to Kepler. :thumbsup:
